create.name: Ananda Sangha Bangalore
create.bio:
Ananda Sangha Bangalore teaches the path of Kriya Yoga as Paramhansa Yogananda gave it, within the global Ananda movement that his disciple Swami Kriyananda founded in 1968. The Bangalore group's spiritual directors are Nayaswami Haridas and Nayaswami Roma, under Ananda's worldwide leaders Nayaswamis Jyotish and Devi.

Its ashram and main centre occupies the first floor of a building in Basavanagudi, in the south of the city, and is open to visitors at weekends. In-person classes are held there, with parallel batches online. Students follow a four-stage course: lessons in meditation and Yogananda's Energization Exercises, then the art and science of raja yoga, then a stage on the relationship of guru and disciple, and finally preparation for Kriya initiation itself. A one-day Learn to Meditate class introduces the Hong-Sau concentration technique for those who want a shorter start.

Alongside the course, the centre runs weekly group meditations on Thursdays and Saturdays, Sunday satsangs, chanting workshops and Bhagavad Gita study, as well as a Sunday school for children, choir practice, retreats and pilgrimages. Its website gathers guided Energization Exercise practice and recorded talks by Kriyananda and Ananda's senior teachers.

courses.title: The Path of Kriya Yoga course (Levels 1–4)
courses.description: A staged course at the Basavanagudi centre and online: first meditation and the Energization Exercises, then raja yoga in theory and practice, then the guru–disciple relationship, and lastly preparation for Kriya initiation. Upcoming batches include Level 1 in person on 5 December 2026 and Level 2 online from 22 November 2026.

free_resources.title: Paramhansa Yogananda's Energization Exercises
free_resources.description: An introduction to Yogananda's set of 39 Energization Exercises and their principles of will, tension and relaxation, with a guided practice led by Nayaswami Gyandev.

free_resources.title: Satsangs and inspiration: recorded talks
free_resources.description: A gathering of recorded talks: Swami Kriyananda on the Bhagavad Gita and in question-and-answer sessions, and satsangs by Ananda's senior Nayaswamis.
